{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The island’s economy has been shrinking or stagnant for a decade.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The official unemployment rate in Puerto Rico is nearly 12 percent.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Lawmakers in Washington and San Juan need to come up with a plan that addresses the financial and economic problems of Puerto Rico, which must include a lowering of the debt burden borne by Puerto Rico.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The federal government failed to bail out Detroit devastated by disinvestment by the auto industry.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Puerto Rico must not be allowed to suffer due to disinvestment by biopharmaceuticals and other industries that have moved abroad in search of even cheaper production costs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Government-owned companies such as the electric utility in Puerto Rico are not allowed to restructure their debt in Chapter 9 bankruptcies because Puerto Rico is a territory.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Twenty-five percent of Puerto Rican debt is held by state-owned enterprises.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Congress should approve a new bill that would allow Puerto Rican government-owned companies, as well as municipalities, to use Chapter 9.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Most Democrats support legislation allowing Puerto Rican government-owned companies and municipalities to use Chapter 9.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans are steadfastly opposed to legislation allowing Puerto Rican government-owned companies and municipalities to use Chapter 9.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"If need be, the entire government of Puerto Rico should be able to file for bankruptcy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"States cannot file under Chapter 9, but Puerto Rico is not a state.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
